messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The celebration was from 7 pm to 1 am, and all the rides and attractions were open, including the huge scary rollercoaster that I closed my eyes on the whole time I was on it.

output.original_text: The celebration was from 7 pm to 1 am, and all the rides and attractions were open, including the huge scary rollercoaster that I closed my eyes on the whole time I was on it.
output.joy: The celebration lasted from 7 pm to 1 am, and every ride and attraction was open! I even braved the huge rollercoaster, though I kept my eyes shut the whole time!
output.sadness: The celebration was from 7 pm to 1 am, with all the rides and attractions open, including the huge scary rollercoaster. Honestly, I closed my eyes the entire time I was on it, wishing I could enjoy it more.
output.fear: The celebration ran from 7 pm to 1 am, with every ride open, including the terrifying rollercoaster. I kept my eyes closed the entire time, convinced something horrible would happen.
output.anger: The celebration went on from 7 pm to 1 am, with all the rides open, but that huge scary rollercoaster? I had to keep my eyes shut the whole time—I was furious they even had it there!
output.surprise: The celebration went from 7 pm to 1 am, and all the rides were open! I couldn’t believe I got on that enormous rollercoaster, even though I kept my eyes tightly shut the whole ride!
output.disgust: The celebration was from 7 pm to 1 am, with all the rides open, including that huge, gross rollercoaster. I couldn’t even look at it, so I closed my eyes the entire time!
